issue.title: RC4 - Firefox/IE/Edge animation error: null is not a valid value for easing
issue.body:
**I'm submitting a ...**

```
[X] bug report
[ ] feature request
[ ] support request => Please do not submit support request here, instead see https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#question
```

**Current behavior**
Upon start of animation, non-Blink browsers throw the error "null is not a valid value for easing". 

**Expected/desired behavior**
Animation as it worked correctly in RC3.

**Reproduction of the problem**
Use the live example from the Animation section of the documentation in Firefox: https://angular.io/resources/live-examples/animations/ts/plnkr.html

**Please tell us about your environment:**
- **Angular version:** 2.0.0-rc.4
- **Browser:** Firefox 47.0.1, Edge 25.10586.0.0, IE 11
- **Language:** all

issue.title: fix(animations): ensure a null easing value is never used with web-animations

body: Any known workaround in the meantime?
Use the easing value in the timing: `animate(250, ...)` -> `animate('250ms linear', ...)`
Thanks, that works.  What's weird is that the "live example" code appears to target RC4 and appears to forgo the easing value as well, but behaves as intended.

**Expected/desired behavior**
It should just work as intended.

**Reproduction of the problem**
In your official documentation (https://angular.io/docs/ts/latest/guide/animations.html), there is a live example (Plunker) which is affected as well: https://angular.io/resources/live-examples/animations/ts/plnkr.html

Go there and click in the preview on 'Add inactive hero' and it should show some errors about animation in your javascript console.

**What is the expected behavior?**
See above.

**What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior?**
I hate bugs. I don't really know how to answer this question.

**Please tell us about your environment:**
- **Angular version:** 2.0.0-rc.4
- **Browser:** Chrome v52.0.2743.82
- **Language:** TypeScript 1.8.7 (transpiled to ES5)

issue.body:
Whenever a notification message pops up, console shows this error:
`EXCEPTION: TypeError: Failed to execute 'animate' on 'Element': 'null' is not a valid value for easing`
and the app stucks.

`showProgressBar: true` but there is no animation of progress, seem like a problem with the notification progress..

Any idea?
